title: SQL Injection in Search Parameter (Synthetic)
description: The application constructs dynamic SQL queries directly from user input without parameterization in the asset search endpoint. (Synthetic laboratory finding).

evidence.response: HTTP/1.1 200 OK - Syntax error in SQL statement / SQLite exception returned unexpected records
evidence.observation: Differential error response and timing variance confirmed unescaped SQL parameter interpolation

remediation: Use parameterized queries or prepared statements via an ORM or database driver. Never concatenate unvalidated user input into SQL commands.

title: Hardcoded JWT Secret Key in Application Configuration (Synthetic)
description: Static analysis detected a default weak HMAC secret ('change-this-to-a-random-secret-key') used to sign authorization tokens. (Synthetic laboratory finding).
remediation: Generate a cryptographically secure random key with at least 256 bits of entropy and supply it via an environment variable or secrets manager.

title: Cross-Site Scripting (Reflected XSS) in Error Page (Synthetic)
description: User-supplied error parameter is reflected in the HTML response without HTML entity encoding or Content-Security-Policy restrictions. (Synthetic laboratory finding).
remediation: Apply contextual output encoding using standard templating engines with auto-escaping enabled and implement a strict Content-Security-Policy (CSP) header.

title: Missing Security Headers on Web Service (Synthetic)
description: The HTTP response headers omit Strict-Transport-Security (HSTS), X-Content-Type-Options, and Content-Security-Policy headers.
remediation: Configure the reverse proxy or web application framework to send modern defense-in-depth security headers on all responses.

title: Server Version Banner Disclosure (Synthetic)
description: The HTTP response Server header exposes internal web server product name and version number ('Server: Apache/2.4.41 (Ubuntu)').
remediation: Suppress detailed server banners in the server configuration (e.g., ServerTokens Prod, ServerSignature Off).
